spec.description: Modifies the parameters of a live order in-place, without cancelling and re-creating it: order identifiers stay the same, queue priority in the order book is maintained where possible, and if the amendment reduces the order quantity below the already-filled quantity, the remaining quantity is cancelled. Supersedes the legacy `edit_order` (cancel-replace), which loses queue priority and has several unsupported-order-shape caveats.

request.title: AmendOrderParams
request.description: Parameters for amending a live order in-place. Order identifiers, queue priority (where possible), and existing executions are preserved; if the amendment reduces the order quantity below the already-filled quantity, the remaining quantity is cancelled.

order_id.description: Kraken identifier for the order to amend, e.g. `OFGKYQ-FHPCQ-HUQFEK`. Either `order_id` or `cl_ord_id` is required.

cl_ord_id.description: Client identifier for the order to amend, e.g. `6d1b345e-2821-40e2-ad83-4ecb18a06876`. Either `order_id` or `cl_ord_id` is required.

order_qty.description: New order quantity in terms of the base asset.

display_qty.description: For iceberg orders only: new quantity to show in the book while the rest of the remaining order quantity stays hidden. Minimum value is 1/15 of the remaining order quantity.

limit_price.description: New limit price restriction, used with `limit_price_type`. For order types that support a limit price only.

limit_price_type.description: Units for `limit_price`: `static` (a static market price), `pct` (a percentage offset from the reference price), or `quote` (a notional offset in the quote currency). `static` is the default for all order types except `trailing-stop-limit`, which defaults to `quote`. Currently only available on trailing-stop-limit orders.

post_only.description: Optional for limit-price amends. If `true`, rejects the limit-price change if the order cannot be posted passively in the book.

trigger_price.description: New trigger price to activate the order, used with `trigger_price_type`. For triggered order types only.

trigger_price_type.description: Units for `trigger_price`. For triggered order types only.

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp, millisecond precision. Valid offsets from the current time range from 500ms to 60s (default 5s). The engine will not match this order after this time.

symbol.description: Required on amends for non-crypto pairs, i.e. provide the pair symbol for xstocks, e.g. `TSLAx/USD`.

amend_id.description: Unique Kraken identifier generated for this amend transaction.

order_id.description: Kraken order identifier, if populated in the request.

cl_ord_id.description: Client identifier, if populated in the request.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the amend, if any.

notes: `token` (the auth bearer token) is documented by Kraken as a required params field but is deliberately absent from this schema: `core/transport/ws.py`'s `SocketConnection.rpc_send` merges the cached token into every outgoing `params` on the private connection -- trading calls and subscribe/unsubscribe alike -- so it is transport-injected, never a caller-supplied argument, the same way `req_id` (the declared `correlate` field) never appears in a requestBody schema. Either `order_id` or `cl_ord_id` identifies the order to amend; both are declared as independently-optional string fields (not JSON Schema `required`) since this is an either-or business rule over the same shape, not a discriminated union `anyOf` would fit -- documented in each field's description instead, per the same reasoning as `cancel_order`.
